title: CatalogClaim
description: Defines a single property within a Document's credentialSubject. A Claim is the atomic unit of verified data: it maps a human-readable label (in multiple languages) to a JSON-LD term, declares its type and validation rules, and controls how it participates in selective disclosure and form presentation.

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID v4). Generated by the server on creation.

document_id.description: Reference to the parent Document (Verifiable Credential type) that contains this claim.

key.description: camelCase property name used as the key within the credentialSubject JSON (e.g. 'givenName', 'birthDate', 'taxIdentificationNumber'). Unique within a document. Immutable after creation.

semantic_id.description: JSON-LD semantic identifier linking this claim to a well-known vocabulary term. Enables cross-system interoperability. Examples: 'https://schema.org/givenName', 'https://schema.org/birthDate', 'https://www.w3.org/2018/credentials/examples#alumniOf'.

path.description: Dot-notation JSON path for nested credentialSubject properties (e.g. 'address.streetAddress', 'degree.type'). Null for top-level properties. The full resolved key in the credential is path+'.'+key when path is present.

translations.description: Multilingual metadata. Each key is a BCP 47 language tag. The entry keyed by 'default_lang_code' is the canonical version.

default_lang_code.description: BCP 47 language tag for the primary language. MUST correspond to a key present in 'translations'.

data_type.description: Primitive type aligned with JSON Schema types and XSD datatypes. Used during VC validation and form rendering. 'date' maps to xsd:date (YYYY-MM-DD). 'datetime' maps to xsd:dateTime (ISO 8601).

constraints.description: JSON Schema-compatible validation constraints for the claim value. Applied when validating credential subjects.

regex_pattern.description: Additional ECMAScript regex for value validation (for 'string' data_type). Applied after type and constraints checks.

regex_flags.description: ECMAScript regex flags for regex_pattern (e.g. 'i' for case-insensitive).

essential.description: When true, this claim is essential and MUST be present in any issued Verifiable Credential of the parent Document type. Maps to 'essential: true' in W3C VC presentation requests.

selective_disclosure_policy.description: Controls participation in selective disclosure (BBS+, SD-JWT). 'always_disclosed': the claim is always revealed (e.g. credential type, issuance date). 'selectable': the holder may choose to reveal or hide it. 'never_disclosed': never revealed to verifiers (holder-internal data only). Effective only when the parent Document has 'selective_disclosure: true'.

source_type.description: Origin of the claim value. 'issuer_attested': asserted by the issuing authority. 'self_attested': declared by the credential subject (lower trust level). 'derived': computed from other claims (e.g. age from birthDate).

display.description: UI rendering hints for forms and wallet credential detail views.

label.description: Human-readable claim name displayed in forms and credential detail views.

description.description: Extended description of the claim's meaning and accepted values.

placeholder.description: Input placeholder text shown inside form widgets.

help_text.description: Contextual help text displayed below the input widget (e.g. 'Enter your 9-digit NIF without separators').

error_message.description: Validation error message displayed when the claim value fails constraints or regex validation.

unit.description: Unit of measure suffix (e.g. 'kg', 'cm', 'EUR', '%'). Displayed next to the input widget.

ClaimTranslationMap.description: Keys are BCP 47 language tags. E.g. { 'es': { 'label': 'Nombre' }, 'en': { 'label': 'Given Name' } }

ClaimConstraints.description: JSON Schema-aligned validation constraints. Only applicable constraints for the claim's data_type should be provided.

minLength.description: Minimum string length. Applicable to data_type: string, email, phone, url.

minimum.description: Minimum numeric value (inclusive). Applicable to data_type: number, integer.

multipleOf.description: The value must be a multiple of this number.

minItems.description: Minimum number of items. Applicable to data_type: array.

maxItems.description: Maximum number of items. Applicable to data_type: array.

enum.description: Closed set of allowed values. When present, only these values are valid.

format.description: Semantic format for finer-grained validation beyond data_type (e.g. 'iban' for bank account numbers, 'dninie' for Spanish ID numbers).

ClaimDisplay.description: UI rendering hints used by form builders and wallet credential views.

widget.description: Default UI widget to render for this claim in a form. Can be overridden per-field in a Form.

icon.description: Material Design icon name or absolute URL to an icon asset.

format_pattern.description: Display format string for rendering the claim value in read mode (e.g. 'DD/MM/YYYY' for dates, '€#,##0.00' for amounts).

multiline.description: Hint that the string value may be long and should be rendered in a multiline textarea.
